description: 9 PM Rebel by Afnan is an aromatic fruity fragrance for women and men, opening with pineapple, Granny Smith apple and mandarin. Oakmoss, cedarwood and vanilla form the heart, while dry wood, ambergris, caramel and musk create a sweet, woody base. A bold, tropical-woody composition.
descriptionAr: 9 بي إم ريبل من أفنان عطر عطري فاكهي للنساء والرجال يفتتح بالأناناس وتفاح غراني سميث واليوسفي. يتكون القلب من الأوكموس وخشب الأرز والفانيليا، بينما يمنحه الخشب الجاف والعنبر الرمادي والكراميل والمسك قاعدة حلوة خشبية. تركيبة جريئة استوائية خشبية.

description: 9am by Afnan is a citrus aromatic eau de parfum, opening with lemon, mandarin orange, cardamom and pink pepper. Its heart of lavender, orange blossom, green apple and rose rests on a base of musk, moss, cedar and patchouli.

descriptionAr: أفنان 9 إيه إم دايف عطر عطري مائي للنساء والرجال يفتتح بالليمون والنعناع والكشمش الأسود والفلفل الوردي. يتكون القلب من التفاح والأرز والبخور، على قاعدة من الزنجبيل وخشب الصندل والباتشولي والياسمين. تركيبة منعشة وحيوية.

Crisp grapefruit and modern ambroxan create a bright, uplifting aura over a clean vetiver and cedar base. It is a perfect, reliable "dumb reach" fragrance for the office or gym.

name: ASSAF KING ENABLE EDP
description: ASSAF ASSAF KING ENABLE is a captivating fragrance from the Floral Woody family that opens with refreshing notes of Citrus, Bergamot. It perfectly balances a heart of Jasmine, Rose with a rich base of Musk, Amber, Wood, creating an unforgettable Citrus-Woody accord. Ideal for Daily wear, Evening, this scent appeals to those seeking elegance and sophistication. Experience the finest craftsmanship with this exquisite perfume from France.

name: ASSAF LIPSTICK
description: Assaf Lipstick is an alluring and nostalgic fragrance that perfectly captures the scent of premium vintage cosmetics. Crafted for women, it highlights a luxurious powdery iris and violet accord sweetened by ripe berries and smooth leather. This glamorous and sophisticated scent is ideal for romantic evenings and special occasions.

id: ASSAF MIS SAKURA NATURAL SPRAY 200 ML
name: ASSAF MIS SAKURA NATURAL SPRAY
description: Assaf Miss Sakura is a delicate floral fragrance that captures the fleeting beauty of cherry blossoms in full bloom. Created for young women who prefer soft and elegant scents, it features light floral notes layered over clean white musk. This charming perfume is perfect for daily wear during the spring season.

name: ASSAF MISS AROGATE EDP
description: Radiate confidence with bright Pear and a decadent Vanilla finish. This elegant Amber Floral scent perfectly balances sweetness and sophistication. It is a highly versatile, modern signature fragrance for any occasion.

name: ASSAF MISS GRIS
description: Assaf Miss Gris is a deeply sophisticated chypre floral fragrance inspired by classic Parisian elegance. Dominated by earthy patchouli and fresh rose, it caters to strong, confident individuals. This refined scent performs beautifully during cool fall evenings and formal events.

name: ASSAF MISS SAKURA
description: Assaf Miss Sakura is a delicate and highly joyful fragrance that captures the fleeting beauty of spring with bright cherry blossom and bergamot. A deeply romantic and exceptionally soft heart of rose and jasmine exudes an innocent and graceful femininity. The beautifully clean base of white musk and vanilla creates an uplifting, powdery finish that is absolutely perfect for daytime casual wear.

name: ASSAF NO COMMENT
description: Assaf No Comment is a wildly appealing and versatile fragrance that balances fresh apple and citrus with warm, spicy cinnamon. The smooth vanilla and woody dry-down give it a modern, confident character that is completely effortless to wear. This signature-worthy scent is perfect for any occasion, literally requiring 'no comment' to prove its excellence.

name: ASSAF NOMADE
description: Assaf Nomade is a majestic amber woody fragrance that transports you to the vast, mysterious expanses of the Arabian desert. Rich top notes of saffron and cinnamon seamlessly blend into a luxurious heart of rose and a profound oud-leather base, catering to those who demand pure opulence. Leave a powerful, deeply mesmerizing trail at any evening gala or special event.

name: ASSAF PINK GIFT SET
description: Assaf Pink Gift is a beautiful, highly feminine floral fragrance that celebrates the delicate elegance of the rose. Designed for elegant women, it features a modern and fresh Turkish rose heart accented by sweet litchi and soft cashmere woods. It is an incredibly charming scent, ideal for daytime wear and romantic spring days.

name: ASSAF PRIVATE PURPLE
description: Assaf Private Purple is a luscious and mysterious amber floral fragrance brimming with dark plum, exotic orchid, and warm vanilla. It is crafted for the glamorous and confident woman who loves deep, fruity, and seductive scents. Wear this enchanting perfume on a fun night out or during cool fall evenings.

name: ASSAF REBEL ENABLE
description: Assaf Rebel Enable is an enticing amber woody fragrance featuring zesty lemon and pink pepper. Its sweet vanilla and tonka base is designed for those who dare to stand out. Highly attractive for a night out.

name: ASSAF RISK COMETE
description: Assaf Risk Comete is a dreamy floral woody musk opening with sparkling aldehydes. Its powdery iris and vanilla heart is designed for the romantic and mystical. An enchanting fragrance perfect for intimate evenings.

name: ASSAF TOBACCO JAM 50
description: Assaf Tobacco Jam is a rich, decadent, and highly luxurious amber woody fragrance. Designed for lovers of deep, sweet scents, it features an incredible, mouth-watering blend of sweet vanilla, premium tobacco, and warm cinnamon. This potent and cozy fragrance is the ultimate statement piece for cold winter nights and upscale evening events.

name: ASSAF WILD COLT BAKHUR
description: Assaf Wild Colt Bakhur is a profoundly smoky, untamed amber woody fragrance that boldly captures the raw power of burning Arabian incense. Intense notes of premium bakhoor, heavy leather, and authentic oud combine to create an aura of absolute dominance and extreme luxury. Make an uncompromising, immensely powerful statement during cold winter nights with this highly potent elixir.

id: ASSAF WILD COLT TABACCO EDP 100 ML
name: ASSAF WILD COLT TABACCO EDP
description: Assaf Wild Colt Tabacco is an intensely rich, unapologetically bold fragrance that perfectly captures the sweet, dark essence of pipe tobacco and vanilla. The delicious cacao heart is expertly balanced by a robust and masculine woody base. Highly recommended for fans of sweet tobacco scents, it provides a warm, luxurious aura during the coldest months.

id: ATELIER COLOGNE ROSE ANOYME EDP 100 ML
name: ATELIER COLOGNE ROSE ANOYME EDP
description: Atelier Cologne Rose Anonyme is a breathtakingly modern amber floral that takes the classic rose-oud combination and makes it remarkably fresh. It masterfully intertwines spicy ginger, lush Turkish rose, and dark, smoky incense with a clean patchouli base. This highly sophisticated and mysterious scent is perfect for those who want a deeply romantic, yet edgy signature.
heartNotes: Turkish Rose, Somali Incense, Velvet Oud

name: ATELIER COLOGNE SANTAL CARMIN
description: Atelier Cologne Santal Carmin is a warm, velvety, and deeply comforting amber woody fragrance. Perfectly unisex, it showcases a luxurious, creamy New Caledonian sandalwood brightened by saffron and sweetened by vanilla. This incredibly smooth and inviting scent is highly recommended for cozy fall and winter days.

id: ATELIER COLOGNE VANILLE INSENCSEE EDP 100 ML
name: ATELIER COLOGNE VANILLE INSENCSEE EDP
description: Atelier Cologne Vanille Insensee offers a unique, unsweetened, and highly sophisticated take on vanilla. A brilliant unisex fragrance, it contrasts the comforting warmth of dry vanilla with crisp citrus and earthy oak wood. This elegant and sheer woody scent is perfectly suited for everyday wear during the cooler months.

id: ATELIER DES ORS BOIS SIKAR EDP 100ML
name: ATELIER DES ORS BOIS SIKAR EDP
description: Atelier des Ors Bois Sikar is a wildly captivating and smoky fragrance inspired by the rich aromas of premium cigars and peaty whisky. Intense notes of guaiac wood and styrax blend beautifully with a robust tobacco leaf base. It is a daring, highly sophisticated scent designed for the true aficionado who appreciates deeply resinous, woody perfumes.

name: ATELIER INTENSE POUR HOMME
description: Atelier Intense Pour Homme is an Eau de Parfum for men. The product is presented in an 80 ml size.

name: ATELIER POUR HOMME EDT
description: Awaken your senses with this vibrant Atelier creation, a masterful celebration of sun-drenched, hyper-realistic citrus notes. Bursting with the mouth-watering, tart juiciness of blood orange and balanced by a soft, warm sandalwood base, it is an instant mood booster for anyone seeking pure joy. Phenomenally refreshing, it is the ultimate go-to fragrance for hot summer days, beach trips, and casual, carefree weekends.

id: ATKINSONS 24 OLD BOND STREET ED COLOGNE 100ML

description: Blank Atelier This Is Me is an intimate and comforting floral woody musk featuring soft iris, clean musk, and ambrette. name: ATLIER VERNO DEEP OCEAN EDPX
description: Blank Atelier Verno Deep Ocean offers a profoundly realistic oceanic experience, dominated by highly authentic sea salt and marine accords. The inclusion of bright grapefruit and clean lavender provides a perfectly balanced, refreshing profile. This fragrance is an absolute must-have for lovers of aquatic scents seeking a crisp, summer staple.

id: ATLIER VERNO ON THE ROCK EXDP 100ML
name: ATLIER VERNO ON THE ROCK EXDP
description: BLANK ATLIER VERNO ON THE ROCK EXDP is a masterfully crafted fragrance that captivates from the first spritz with its vibrant top notes. The heart reveals a sophisticated blend of florals, seamlessly transitioning into a warm and enduring base. Perfect for the discerning wearer, this scent leaves a memorable trail that is both elegant and timeless, making it an essential addition to any collection.

name: ATLIER VERNON BLACK EARTH EXDP
description: Atelier Vernon Black Earth is an intensely dark, earthy fragrance that powerfully captures the raw essence of nature. Sharp black pepper gives way to a profound heart of raw vetiver and rich patchouli, drying down to an uncompromising leather and oakmoss base. It is a stunning, bold choice for those who desire a deeply masculine and mysterious scent.

name: ATTAR FULL ROLL ON
description: Attar Full by Nabeel is a concentrated perfume oil built around a luminous white floral heart of jasmine, ylang-ylang and orange blossom, warmed by a soft musk base. Presented in the traditional alcohol-free attar style, it offers a rich, long-wearing floral character. Its 6 ml roll-on format suits both daily wear and layering.

This elegant, radiant scent is a perfect everyday companion for the sophisticated woman who loves a touch of glamour.
baseNotes: Pink Pepper, Amber, Benzoin, White Musk

The vibrant tartness of rhubarb leaf perfectly contrasts the addictive, warm bourbon vanilla base. Housed in a stunning emerald heart bottle, this daring perfume is made for women who want a wildly unconventional signature scent.

Luminous lemon and star anise blend with a deeply spiced heart of geranium and clove, settling onto a luxurious ambergris base. This highly concentrated, long-lasting scent is ideal for fragrance aficionados wanting a truly grand, sophisticated aura.

id: AVATAR INTENSE POUR FEMMI EDP 80 ML
name: AVATAR INTENSE POUR FEMMI EDP

description: Cavalero Aventos Noir Hunaidi is a dynamic and confident fragrance renowned for its striking contrast of juicy pineapple and smoky birch wood. name: AVENTURE RICH&RUITZ EDP
description: Shaya Aventure by Rich & Ruitz is a dynamic chypre fruity fragrance that projects power and success. A vibrant blast of sweet pineapple is perfectly offset by a dry, smoky birch and ambergris base. It is a highly compliment-getting, versatile masculine scent for any time of year.

Tailored for men, it blends aromatic black tea and violet leaf with a clean, comforting base of cedar and musk. This easy-to-wear scent is an excellent daily driver for the office and casual weekends.

descriptionAr: بولغاري أومنيا أميثيست عطر من عائلة الأزهار الخشبية المسكية بطابع ناعم ومسحوق. يفتتح بالغريب فروت الوردي والنوتات الخضراء، لينتقل إلى قلب من الأوريس والورد البلغاري، ويستقر على قاعدة من الهيليوتروب والنوتات الخشبية. تركيبة رقيقة ومتحفظة تناسب النهار.

name: BVLGARI OMNIA CORAL EDT
description: Bvlgari Omnia Coral is a floral fruity fragrance opening with bergamot and goji berries. Its heart combines pomegranate, hibiscus and water lily, resting on a base of musk and Virginia cedar. The result is a bright, sparkling composition suited to warm-weather wear.
descriptionAr: بولغاري أومنيا كورال عطر من عائلة الأزهار الفاكهية يفتتح بالبرغموت وتوت الغوجي. يجمع قلبه بين الرمان والكركديه وزنبق الماء، ويستقر على قاعدة من المسك وخشب الأرز الفرجيني. نتيجته تركيبة مشرقة ومتلألئة تناسب الأجواء الدافئة.

name: BVLGARI OMNIA CRYSTALLINE EDT W
description: Bvlgari Omnia Crystalline is a floral aquatic fragrance with a clean, luminous character. Bamboo and pear open into a heart of lotus, tea and cassia, while musk, guaiac wood and oakmoss form its soft base. It offers a light, transparent composition well suited to everyday wear.
descriptionAr: بولغاري أومنيا كريستالين عطر من عائلة الأزهار المائية بطابع نظيف ومتلألئ. يفتتح بالخيزران والكمثرى، لينتقل إلى قلب من زهرة اللوتس والشاي والكاسيا، بينما يتكون قاعدته من المسك وخشب الغاياك وطحلب البلوط. عطر خفيف وشفاف يناسب الاستخدام اليومي.

id: BVLGARI OMNIA GOLDEN CITRINE EDT 65 ML
name: BVLGARI OMNIA GOLDEN CITRINE EDT
description: Bvlgari Omnia Golden Citrine is an amber floral fragrance opening with white peach and Sicilian mandarin. Ylang-ylang and jasmine form its heart, while benzoin and cedar create a warm, sweet base. It offers a sunny, radiant character for daytime wear.
descriptionAr: بولغاري أومنيا غولدن سيترين عطر من عائلة العنبر الزهري يفتتح بالخوخ الأبيض واليوسفي الصقلي. يتشكل قلبه من الإيلنغ إيلنغ والياسمين، بينما تمنحه قاعدة من البنزوين والأرز دفئاً وحلاوة. يقدم طابعاً مشرقاً ومشعاً للنهار.

id: BVLGARI PARFUMS AQVA POUR HOMME EDT 100 ML T
name: BVLGARI PARFUMS AQVA POUR HOMME EDT 100 ML T
description: Bvlgari Aqva Pour Homme is an aromatic aquatic fragrance built around a marine, citrus character. Mandarin orange, orange and petitgrain open into a heart of seaweed, lavender and cotton flower, resting on a base of Virginia cedar, woodsy notes, patchouli, clary sage and amber. It is a fresh, oceanic composition for warm-weather wear.
descriptionAr: بولغاري أكوا بور هوم عطر من عائلة العطور العطرية المائية بطابع بحري حمضي. يفتتح باليوسفي والبرتقال والبتيتغرين، لينتقل إلى قلب من الأعشاب البحرية والخزامى وزهرة القطن، ويستقر على قاعدة من خشب الأرز الفرجيني والنوتات الخشبية والباتشولي وحكيم قلاري والعنبر. تركيبة منعشة تستحضر أجواء المحيط.
baseNotes: Virginia Cedar, Woodsy Notes, Patchouli, Clary Sage, Amber

id: BVLGARI PETITS ET MAMANS EDT 100 ML
name: BVLGARI PETITS ET MAMANS EDT
description: Bvlgari Petits et Mamans is a gentle, soothing floral woody musk fragrance designed specifically to be shared between mothers and children. It features calming chamomile and soft powdery notes, enriched with a delicate touch of vanilla and white peach. Completely alcohol-free, this comforting scent is perfect for quiet days, cuddles, and bedtime routines.

name: BVLGARI POUR FEMME W EDT
description: A refreshing aromatic blend that combines bright citrus with clean green notes. Its subtle floral heart and musky base cater to a minimalist, effortless style. Great for casual everyday wear.

id: BVLGARI POUR HOMME EXTREME EDT 100 ML

The smooth, luxurious base of sandalwood and refined agarwood leaves an aura of pure wealth and impeccable taste.

A spicy and herbaceous heart of basil and juniper berries adds refined elegance suitable for both men and women. Grounded by Creed's signature ambergris and musk, this versatile scent is an impeccable choice for warm summer days and professional settings.

description: Davidoff Zino is a classic amber woody EDT for men, launched in 1986. It opens with Brazilian rosewood, lavender, clary sage, and bergamot, transitions through a rich floral heart of rose, geranium, and jasmine, and settles into a warm base of patchouli, sandalwood, vanilla, and cedar.
descriptionAr: زينو من ديفيدوف عطر كلاسيكي عنبري خشبي للرجال صدر عام 1986، يُفتح بخشب الورد البرازيلي واللافندر والمريمية البرية والبرغموت، ثم ينتقل إلى قلب زهري غني من الورد والجيرانيوم والياسمين، وينتهي بقاعدة دافئة من الباتشولي والصندل والفانيليا والسيدار.
topNotes: Brazilian Rosewood, Lavender, Clary Sage, Bergamot

id: DAVIDPOFF THE BRILIANT GAME EDT 100 ML TESTER
name: DAVIDPOFF THE BRILIANT GAME EDT
DEEP SENSUAL EDP
description: Al Ain Deep Sensual is a rich, enveloping oriental fragrance that leans heavily into traditional Arabian perfumery. It opens with a brief hint of citrus before immediately plunging into a dense, spicy rose heart. The fragrance is dominated by a powerful, long-lasting dry down of dark oud, warm amber, and musk. This exotic, sensual scent is exclusively tailored for chilly evenings and intimate, special occasions.

name: DEEP WHITE EDP
description: UAE DEEP WHITE is a masterfully crafted fragrance that captivates from the first spritz with its vibrant top notes. The heart reveals a sophisticated blend of florals, seamlessly transitioning into a warm and enduring base. Perfect for the discerning wearer, this scent leaves a memorable trail that is both elegant and timeless, making it an essential addition to any collection.

id: DEHN AL OUD COMBODY EDP 100 ML
name: DEHN AL OUD COMBODY EDP
description: Dehn Al Oud Combodi is a rich, authentic Arabian fragrance centered around the highly prized Cambodian Oud. The scent opens with a deep, resinous, and slightly sweet oud aroma that is profoundly captivating. It evolves with complex earthy and woody nuances, resting on a warm, lingering base of amber and musk. This traditional masterpiece is crafted for connoisseurs of luxury, perfect for making a grand statement at formal gatherings.

name: DELICAT TENDER EDP
description: Vurv Delicat Tender offers a bright and refreshing burst of citrus and sweet peach notes that awaken the senses. Its heart blossoms with delicate peony and lily of the valley, creating a beautifully feminine profile. Resting on a base of white musk and sandalwood, this fragrance is ideal for daytime wear and appeals to women seeking a soft, romantic scent.

name: DELICATE POUR FEMMI EDP
description: Bin Darwesh Delicate Pour Femme is a wonderfully soft and feminine fragrance that begins with an uplifting blend of pear and bergamot. The graceful and purely romantic heart of rose and lily of the valley perfectly embodies youthful elegance and everyday charm. A clean, smooth base of white musk and subtle vanilla makes it a highly versatile and polite choice for the office.
heartNotes: Rose, Jasmine, Lily of the Valley

name: DELICIOUS PINK EDP
description: AL SHAYA DELICIOUS PINK is a masterfully crafted fragrance that captivates from the first spritz with its vibrant top notes. The heart reveals a sophisticated blend of florals, seamlessly transitioning into a warm and enduring base. Perfect for the discerning wearer, this scent leaves a memorable trail that is both elegant and timeless, making it an essential addition to any collection.

name: DELILAH POUR FEMME EDP
description: Maison Alhambra Delilah is an exceptionally beautiful floral fragrance that serves as a stunning, high-quality tribute to modern rose perfumes. A tart, juicy opening of litchi and rhubarb brilliantly highlights a massive, creamy Turkish rose and vanilla heart, making it an ultra-feminine showstopper. Become the center of attention and collect endless compliments with this luxurious, long-lasting signature scent.
heartNotes: Turkish Rose, Peony, Musk, Petalia, Vanilla

name: DEMOISELLE WOMEN EDP
description: Granoeur Demoiselle is a fresh and luminous floral fragrance perfect for bright spring days. It elegantly combines sparkling mandarin with a romantic heart of rose and peony. This uplifting scent is tailored for graceful women who enjoy light, delicate, and sophisticated floral compositions.

name: DERRICK PARIS
description: Derrick by Orlane is a men's eau de toilette in the aromatic fougere family, opening with thyme, lavender, rosemary and tarragon. A spicy green heart of patchouli, pepper, cedar and jasmine leads into a warm base of incense, labdanum, white musk and coumarin, for a classic herbaceous masculine fragrance.
descriptionAr: درك من أورلان هو عطر تواليت رجالي ينتمي إلى عائلة الفوجير العطرية، يفتتح بنفحات الزعتر والخزامى وإكليل الجبل والطرخون. يليه قلب توابلي أخضر من الباتشولي والفلفل والأرز والياسمين، لينتهي بقاعدة دافئة من اللبان واللابدانوم والمسك الأبيض والكومارين، لينتج عطراً رجالياً كلاسيكياً بطابع عشبي.
heartNotes: Patchouli, Pepper, Nutmeg, Cedar, Caraway, Pine Tree, Geranium, Jasmine

id: DESEL SORIT OF THE BRAVE EDP 125 ML
name: DESEL SORIT OF THE BRAVE EDP
description: Discover the captivating allure of DIESEL DESEL SORIT OF THE BRAVE, a masterfully blended woody floral fragrance. It opens with vibrant bergamot, citrus, pink pepper, leading into a sophisticated heart of rose, jasmine, floral accords that perfectly balances the composition. Anchored by a warm base of musk, vanilla, sandalwood, this scent is ideal for everyday wear, spring/summer and offers an unforgettable olfactory experience for the modern enthusiast.

name: DESERT SCENT EDT
description: Embark on an exotic journey with precious Oud and Saffron. This rich Amber Woody fragrance creates a powerful, mesmerizing trail. It stands as a true symbol of luxury for grand occasions.

name: DESIRADE AUBUSSON EDT
description: Desirade by Aubusson is an amber floral EDT for women, launched in 1990. It opens with ylang-ylang, aldehydes, pineapple, coriander, and bergamot, transitions into a rich floral heart of tuberose, jasmine, osmanthus, and rose, and finishes with a warm base of sandalwood, opoponax, and vanilla.
descriptionAr: ديزيراد من أوبيسون عطر عنبري زهري للنساء صدر عام 1990، يُفتح بالإيلانج إيلانج والألدهايدات والأناناس والكزبرة والبرغموت، ثم ينتقل إلى قلب زهري ثري من توبروز والياسمين والأوسمانثوس والورد، وينتهي بقاعدة دافئة من الصندل والأوبوبوناكس والفانيليا.
heartNotes: Osmanthus, Tuberose, Cassia, Jasmine, Orange Blossom, Violet, Rose
baseNotes: Sandalwood, Opoponax, Vanilla, Plum, Musk, Patchouli, Raspberry

id: DEUX CENT VIP BLACK EDP 100 ML
name: DEUX CENT VIP BLACK EDP
description: Fragrance World Deux Cent VIP Black is a highly energetic and magnetic fragrance that kicks off with a daring shot of absinthe and anise. A smooth, exceptionally clean heart of aromatic lavender provides a modern, masculine core designed to keep you fresh all night. The deeply sensual base of black vanilla and musk creates an irresistible, party-ready aura that demands attention.

id: DIESE ONLY THE BRAVE MAN EDT 125 ML
name: DIESE ONLY THE BRAVE MAN EDT
description: Diesel Only The Brave is an amber woody EDT for men, launched in 2009. It opens with Amalfi lemon and mandarin orange, transitions into a heart of violet, Virginia cedar, and coriander, and finishes with a warm base of amber, leather, benzoin, labdanum, and styrax.
descriptionAr: أونلي ذا برايف من ديزل عطر عنبري خشبي للرجال صدر عام 2009، يُفتح بليمون أمالفي والماندرين، ثم ينتقل إلى قلب من البنفسج والسيدار الفيرجيني والكزبرة، وينتهي بقاعدة دافئة من العنبر والجلد والبنزوين واللابدانوم والستيراكس.
baseNotes: Amber, Leather, Benzoin, French Labdanum, Styrax

name: DIESEL BAD INTENSE EDP
description: Diesel Bad is a daring and provocative woody aromatic fragrance that introduces a unique, salty caviar note to modern perfumery. Featuring a rugged blend of tobacco, lavender, and woods, it is aimed at the rebellious, edgy man who loves the "bad boy" aesthetic. This bold and seductive scent is perfect for nights out, casual clubbing, and confident evening wear.
baseNotes: Woody Notes, Tobacco, Ambroxan, Tonka Bean, Patchouli

id: DIESEL FUEL FOR LIFE EDT MAN 125 ML
name: DIESEL FUEL FOR LIFE EDT MAN
description: Diesel Fuel for Life Homme is an aromatic fougere EDT for men, launched in 2007. It opens with anise and grapefruit, deepens into a heart of raspberry and lavender, and finishes with a sweet woody base of heliotrope and woodsy notes.
descriptionAr: فيول فور لايف هوم من ديزل عطر فوجيري عطري للرجال صدر عام 2007، يُفتح بنوتات اليانسون والجريب فروت، ثم ينتقل إلى قلب من التوت واللافندر، وينتهي بقاعدة حلوة خشبية من الهيليوتروب وأخشاب عطرية.

id: DIESEL FUEL FOR LIFE MAN 125 ML
name: DIESEL FUEL FOR LIFE MAN
description: Diesel Fuel for Life is an energetic aromatic fougere that pulses with bold and unconventional notes. Featuring a striking combination of sweet raspberry, anise, and powdery heliotrope, it leaves a highly distinctive trail. This vibrant fragrance is crafted for the adventurous, young-at-heart man who loves to stand out from the crowd.

id: DIESEL FUEL FOR LIFE SPIRIT EDT MEN 75ML
name: DIESEL FUEL FOR LIFE SPIRIT EDT MEN
description: Diesel Fuel for Life Spirit is an amber fougere EDT for men, launched in 2013. It opens with cinnamon and bergamot, transitions into a floral heart of iris and orange blossom, and finishes with a warm base of amber, incense, and woody notes.
descriptionAr: فيول فور لايف سبيريت من ديزل عطر فوجيري عنبري للرجال صدر عام 2013، يُفتح بالقرفة والبرغموت، ثم ينتقل إلى قلب زهري من الأيريس وزهر البرتقال، وينتهي بقاعدة دافئة من العنبر والبخور والأخشاب العطرية.

name: DIESEL LOVERDOSE EDP WOMEN
description: Diesel Loverdose is an amber vanilla EDP for women, launched in 2011. It opens with star anise and mandarin orange, deepens into a rich heart of licorice, jasmine, and gardenia, and settles into a warm base of vanilla, amber, and woody notes.
descriptionAr: لوفردوز من ديزل عطر فانيليا عنبري للنساء صدر عام 2011، يُفتح بنوتات اليانسون النجمي والماندرين، ثم ينتقل إلى قلب ثري من العرقسوس والياسمين والجاردينيا، وينتهي بقاعدة دافئة من الفانيليا والعنبر والأخشاب العطرية.

id: DIESEL ONLY THE BRAVE EDT 75 ML
name: DIESEL ONLY THE BRAVE EDT
description: Diesel Only The Brave is a bold amber woody fragrance known for its iconic fist-shaped bottle and confident aura. Blending punchy lemon with sweet amber and a rugged leather base, it targets energetic, youthful men. A fantastic, highly versatile everyday scent that perfectly balances freshness with masculine warmth.

id: DIESEL ONLY THE BRAVE TATTOO EDT MEN 75ML
name: DIESEL ONLY THE BRAVE TATTOO EDT MEN
description: Diesel Only The Brave Tattoo is a daring, sweet woody spicy fragrance designed for the rebellious man who writes his own rules. An addictive opening of crisp red apple is powerfully contrasted by a dark, mysterious base of tobacco and sweet benzoin. Ignite the night with this highly magnetic, edgy, and profoundly masculine scent.

id: DIESEL ONLY THE BRAVE WILD EDT 75ML TESTER
name: DIESEL ONLY THE BRAVE WILD EDT
DIESEL PLUS MASCULINE EDT
description: Diesel Plus Plus Masculine is a nostalgic amber woody fragrance housed in a unique milk carton design. Featuring a clean blend of orange, tonka bean, and palm leaf, it is perfect for easygoing men. An affordable, comforting classic that is excellent for casual daytime wear.

name: DIESL OTB WILD TESTER DAMEGE
description: Diesel Only The Brave Wild is a rugged aromatic fougere that captures raw, untamed energy. Blending exotic lemongrass with coconut water and cedar, it attracts the bold, adventurous man. This fresh and spicy scent is the ultimate companion for active summer days.

id: DIOR ADDICT EAU FRAICHE EDT W 100ML
name: DIOR ADDICT EAU FRAICHE EDT W
description: Embrace sparkling energy with zesty Grapefruit and Lotus. This Floral Fruity scent is incredibly light and refreshing. It is the ultimate signature fragrance for sunny, casual days.

name: DIOR DIORAMA EDT
description: Dior Diorama is a legendary vintage chypre fruity fragrance that represents the absolute height of classic haute parfumerie. It features a complex, highly sophisticated blend of ripe plum, lush white florals, and a deeply earthy, animalic mossy base. This masterpiece is meant for the true aficionado looking to experience the golden age of French perfumery.

name: DIOR DIORELLA EDT WOMEN
description: Dior Diorella is a quintessential vintage chypre floral fragrance that embodies carefree, bohemian elegance. It opens with a uniquely refreshing blend of overripe melon, bright lemon, and crushed basil. A lush, fruity-floral heart of peach and honeysuckle rests on a classic, earthy base of oakmoss and vetiver. This timeless, airy masterpiece is the perfect daytime companion for the chic woman enjoying warm, sunny days.
topNotes: Melon, Bergamot, Lemon, Basil, Green Notes
heartNotes: Peach, Honeysuckle, Rose, Carnation, Cyclamen, Jasmine

name: DIOR EAU SAUVAGE COLOGE
description: Dior Eau Sauvage Cologne is a timeless and impeccably fresh fragrance that sparkles with premium Calabrian bergamot and bright mandarin. The refined heart of crisp vetiver and subtle petitgrain offers a bright, sunny character that epitomizes classic French grooming. Its clean musk and oakmoss base makes this an effortlessly elegant choice for warm weather and relaxed daytime activities.

name: DIOR EAU SAUVAGE EDT
description: Dior Eau Sauvage, launched in 1966, is a citrus aromatic Eau de Toilette opening with lemon, bergamot, basil, rosemary and caraway. Its heart blends jasmine, coriander, carnation, patchouli, orris root, sandalwood, rose and lavender over a base of oakmoss, vetiver, musk and amber, forming one of perfumery's classic masculine citrus compositions.
descriptionAr: ديور أو سوفاج أو دو تواليت الذي أُطلق عام 1966، عطر رجالي من عائلة الحمضيات والأروماتيك، يفتتح بالليمون والبرغموت والريحان وإكليل الجبل والكراوية، ويتوسطه الياسمين والكزبرة والقرنفل والباتشولي وجذر السوسن والصندل والورد واللافندر، لينتهي بقاعدة من الأوكموس والفيتيفر والمسك والعنبر، فيُعد من كلاسيكيات العطور الرجالية الحمضية.
topNotes: Lemon, Bergamot, Basil, Rosemary, Caraway, Fruity Notes
heartNotes: Jasmine, Coriander, Carnation, Patchouli, Orris Root, Sandalwood, Rose, Lavender, Hedione

id: DIOR EAU SAUVAGE EXTREME EDT 100 ML
name: DIOR EAU SAUVAGE EXTREME EDT
description: CHRISTIAN DIOR DIOR EAU SAUVAGE EXTREME is a masterfully crafted fragrance that captivates from the first spritz with its vibrant top notes. The heart reveals a sophisticated blend of florals, seamlessly transitioning into a warm and enduring base. Perfect for the discerning wearer, this scent leaves a memorable trail that is both elegant and timeless, making it an essential addition to any collection.

name: DIOR HIGHER EDT
description: Dior Higher, launched in 2001, is a woody aromatic Eau de Toilette opening with pear, basil, lemon and peach. Its heart of cypress, rosemary, pepper and cardamom rests on a base of musk and cedar, giving a fresh, aromatic character with a slightly fruity edge.
descriptionAr: ديور هاير أو دو تواليت الذي أُطلق عام 2001، عطر رجالي من عائلة الخشب والأروماتيك، يفتتح بالكمثرى والريحان والليمون والخوخ، ويتوسطه السرو وإكليل الجبل والفلفل والهيل، لينتهي بقاعدة من المسك والأرز تمنحه طابعاً منعشاً وأروماتيكياً مع لمسة فاكهية.

name: DIOR HOME EDT
description: Dior Homme Eau de Toilette (current formulation) is a woody fragrance for men opening with bergamot, pink pepper and elemi. Its heart of Atlas cedar, cashmere wood and patchouli rests on a base of Iso E Super, Haitian vetiver and white musk, giving an intensely woody, warm and sensual signature.
descriptionAr: ديور هوم أو دو تواليت (التركيبة الحالية) عطر رجالي من عائلة الخشب، يفتتح بالبرغموت والفلفل الوردي والإيلمي، ويتوسطه أرز الأطلس وخشب الكشمير والباتشولي، لينتهي بقاعدة من إيزو إي سوبر وفيتيفر هايتي والمسك الأبيض، ليمنح توقيعاً خشبياً دافئاً وحسياً.
baseNotes: Iso E Super, Haitian Vetiver, White Musk

name: DIOR HOMME COLONGE EDT
description: Dior Homme Cologne is a citrus aromatic fragrance for men built on just a few notes: Calabrian bergamot, grapefruit blossom and white musk. Its minimalist composition delivers a clean, fresh character suited to warm weather.
descriptionAr: ديور هوم كولون عطر رجالي من عائلة الحمضيات والأروماتيك يقوم على عدد محدود من النوتات: البرغموت الكالابري وزهر الغريبفروت والمسك الأبيض، ليقدم تركيبة بسيطة ونظيفة ومنعشة تناسب الأجواء الدافئة.

name: DIOR HOMME PARFUM 75ML NEW CODE
description: Dior Homme Parfum is a leather fragrance for men built around iris, woody and powdery facets. It opens with Tuscan iris and Italian orange, moves into a heart of leather and rose, and settles into a base of sandalwood, ambrette, agarwood and cedar. The result is a refined, sophisticated leather composition with a soft powdery finish.
descriptionAr: عطر ديور أوم بارفان هو عطر جلدي للرجال يتمحور حول السوسن والخشب واللمسات البودرية. يفتح بنفحات السوسن التوسكاني والبرتقال الإيطالي، لينتقل إلى قلب من الجلد والورد، ثم يستقر على قاعدة من خشب الصندل والمسك النباتي وخشب العود والأرز. يمنح هذا التوليف الأنيق طابعاً جلدياً راقياً بلمسة بودرية ناعمة.

name: DIOR HOMME SPORT EDT
description: Dior Homme Sport is a woody spicy eau de toilette for men that pairs bright citrus with warm resinous spice. Lemon, bergamot and aldehydes open the composition, leading into elemi and pink pepper before settling into a base of woody notes, amber and olibanum. It offers a fresh, luminous character suited to daytime wear.
descriptionAr: ديور أوم سبورت هو عطر خشبي حار من فئة الإيدي تواليت للرجال يجمع بين الحمضيات المنعشة والتوابل الراتنجية الدافئة. يفتح بنفحات الليمون والبرغموت والألدهيدات، لينتقل إلى الإيلمي والفلفل الوردي، ثم يستقر على قاعدة من النوتات الخشبية والعنبر واللبان. يمنح شخصية منعشة ومشرقة تناسب الارتداء النهاري.

id: DIOR JADORE EDP 100 ML NEW BARCODE
name: DIOR JADORE EDP 100 ML NEW BARCODE
description: CHRISTIAN DIOR DIOR JADORE BARCODE is a masterfully crafted fragrance that captivates from the first spritz with its vibrant top notes. The heart reveals a sophisticated blend of florals, seamlessly transitioning into a warm and enduring base. Perfect for the discerning wearer, this scent leaves a memorable trail that is both elegant and timeless, making it an essential addition to any collection.

id: DIOR MISS DIOR BLOOMING BOUQUET EDT 100ML
name: DIOR MISS DIOR BLOOMING BOUQUET EDT
description: Dior Miss Dior Blooming Bouquet is a tender, ultra-feminine fragrance that perfectly captures the scent of a fresh, dewy spring morning. It opens with a bright, delicate splash of Sicilian mandarin. The heart is a gorgeous, sheer blend of pink peony and Damask rose, subtly sweetened by peach and apricot, ending on a clean white musk base. It is a stunning, inoffensive signature for the elegant, romantic young woman.
heartNotes: Pink Peony, Damask Rose, Apricot, Peach

id: DIOR MISS DIOR BLOOMING BOUQUET EDT GIFT SET
name: DIOR MISS DIOR BLOOMING BOUQUET EDT GIFT SET
description: Miss Dior Blooming Bouquet is a tender and delicate floral fragrance that opens with a refreshing splash of Sicilian mandarin. The heart is a beautiful, airy composition of pink peony and Damask rose, resting on a soft bed of white musk. Perfect for romantic dates and spring days, it is aimed at young women who love a fresh, graceful scent.

id: DIOR MISS DIOR EDP NEW 100 ML
name: DIOR MISS DIOR EDP NEW
description: Miss Dior Eau de Parfum is a chypre floral fragrance for women centered on rose and citrus. It opens with pink pepper and a blend of blood, sweet and mandarin orange with Calabrian bergamot and lemon, unfolds into a heart of Grasse rose, Damask rose and jasmine leaf, and settles over a base of patchouli and rosewood. The composition is bright, rosy and elegantly structured.
descriptionAr: ميس ديور أو دو بارفان عطر شيبري زهري نسائي يتمحور حول الورد والحمضيات. يفتح بالفلفل الوردي ومزيج من البرتقال الدموي والحلو واليوسفي مع برغموت كالابريا والليمون، لينفتح على قلب من ورد جراس والورد الدمشقي وأوراق الياسمين، ثم يستقر على قاعدة من الباتشولي وخشب الورد. يتميز التوليف بإشراقة وردية وبنية أنيقة.
topNotes: Pink Pepper, Blood Orange, Sweet Orange, Mandarin Orange, Calabrian Bergamot, Lemon
heartNotes: Grasse Rose, Damask Rose, Jasmine Leaf

name: DIOR MISS DIOR PARFUM
description: Miss Dior Parfum is a chypre fruity fragrance for women built on woody, fruity and amber facets. It opens with apricot, peach and mandarin orange, moves into a heart of wild strawberry, floral notes and jasmine, and settles into a base of patchouli, amberwood, amber, moss and Atlas cedar. The result is a plush, fruity-floral composition with a warm woody drydown.
descriptionAr: ميس ديور بارفان عطر شيبري فاكهي نسائي يقوم على ملامح خشبية وفاكهية وعنبرية. يفتح بالمشمش والخوخ واليوسفي، لينتقل إلى قلب من الفراولة البرية ونفحات زهرية والياسمين، ثم يستقر على قاعدة من الباتشولي وخشب العنبر والعنبر والطحلب وأرز الأطلس. يتميز بتركيبة فاكهية زهرية فخمة بقاعدة خشبية دافئة.
baseNotes: Patchouli, Amberwood, Amber, Moss, Atlas Cedar

id: DIOR MISS DIOR SCENTED BLOOMING POWDER 16 gm
name: DIOR MISS DIOR SCENTED BLOOMING POWDER 16 gm
description: Miss Dior Scented Blooming Powder is a luxurious body product that softly perfumes the skin with the romantic scent of Miss Dior Blooming Bouquet. Shimmering with notes of pink peony, damask rose, and white musk, it is perfect for women who desire a subtle, elegant fragrance touch. Use this delicately milled powder after a bath to enhance your favorite floral perfumes with a luminous glow.
heartNotes: Pink Peony, Damask Rose, Apricot, Peach

id: DIOR PARFUM POUR LES CHEVEUX HAIR MIST 30ML N
name: DIOR PARFUM POUR LES CHEVEUX HAIR MIST 30ML N
DIOR SAUVAGE BODY SPRAY
description: Dior Sauvage Body Spray provides a refreshing, air-powered way to apply the world-famous, wildly popular aromatic fougere fragrance. Retaining the signature blast of Calabrian bergamot, pepper, and ambroxan, it is perfect for the modern man who wants an instant freshness boost. Highly convenient and durable, it is the ultimate choice for carrying in a gym bag, quick touch-ups, and casual everyday wear.
heartNotes: Sichuan Pepper, Lavender, Pink Pepper, Vetiver, Patchouli, Geranium, Elemi

id: DIOR SAUVAGE EAU FORTE PARFUM 100 ML
name: DIOR SAUVAGE EAU FORTE PARFUM
description: Sauvage Eau Forte is an aromatic fougere fragrance for men presented in Dior's alcohol-free parfum concentration. It opens with cold spices and elemi resin, carried by a lavender heart, and settles into a musky, woody base. The composition delivers an intense yet fresh, blanched-lavender character.
descriptionAr: سوفاج أو فورت عطر عطري فوجير للرجال يقدم بتركيز البارفان الخالي من الكحول من ديور. يفتح بالتوابل الباردة وراتنج الإيلمي، مدعوماً بقلب من الخزامى، ليستقر على قاعدة مسكية خشبية. يمنح التوليف طابعاً قوياً ومنعشاً بلمسة خزامى مبيّضة.

name: DIOR SAUVAGE ELIXIR
description: Discover the captivating allure of CHRISTIAN DIOR DIOR SAUVAGE ELIXIR, a masterfully blended aromatic fougere fragrance. It opens with vibrant bergamot, pepper, grapefruit, leading into a sophisticated heart of geranium, lavender, elemi that perfectly balances the composition. Anchored by a warm base of ambroxan, cedar, patchouli, this scent is ideal for signature scent, all seasons and offers an unforgettable olfactory experience for the modern enthusiast.

name: DIPLOMATE LEGEND EDT
description: Cyrus Diplomate Legend is a polished and reliable woody aromatic fragrance that opens with a bright splash of bergamot and mandarin. The aromatic heart of lavender and violet adds a classic, barbershop elegance, while the tonka bean and sandalwood base provide a smooth finish. It is an excellent, affordable signature scent tailored for the modern, professional man.

name: DIPTYQUE DOSON EDP
description: Do Son Eau de Parfum by Diptyque is a sun-drenched white floral fragrance inspired by memories of Indochina. At its heart is a rich, creamy, and fresh tuberose surrounded by jasmine and orange blossom. A gentle base of musk and amberwood lends a warm, skin-like softness to this luminous floral.
descriptionAr: دو سون أو دو بارفيم من ديبتيك عطر أبيض زهري مشمس مستوحى من ذكريات الهند الصينية. يتمحور حول قلب من الطبروش الغني والكريمي والطازج، محاطًا بالياسمين وزهر البرتقال. تمنح قاعدة لطيفة من المسك وخشب العنبر نعومةً دافئة وجلدية لهذا العطر الزهري المتألق.

name: DIPTYQUE DOSON EDT
description: Diptyque Do Son is a stunningly realistic and intoxicating white floral fragrance inspired by childhood memories of Indochina. The scent is utterly dominated by a lush, creamy, and fresh tuberose, complemented by nuances of orange blossom and pink pepper. The delicate base of musk and benzoin softens the floral intensity, providing a clean, lingering finish. It is a must-have for white floral lovers seeking an elegant, natural-smelling signature for daytime wear.

name: DIPTYQUE EAU MOHELI EDT
description: Eau Mohéli by Diptyque is a tropical floral fragrance centered on the ylang-ylang flower, capturing its exotic character without heaviness. Ginger and pink pepper add a lively spice to the opening, while the floral heart remains bright and airy. A woody-resinous base of vetiver, benzoin, and patchouli lends earthy depth to this sun-kissed composition.
descriptionAr: أو موهيلي من ديبتيك عطر زهري استوائي يتمحور حول زهرة الإيلانغ إيلانغ، مجسِّدًا طابعها الغريب دون ثقل. يُضيف الزنجبيل والفلفل الوردي بهجةً توابلية على الافتتاح، بينما يبقى القلب الزهري مضيئًا وهوائيًا. تمنح قاعدة راتنجية خشبية من الفيتيفير والبنزوين والباتشولي عمقًا ترابيًا لهذه التركيبة المشمسة.

name: DIPTYQUE EAU RIHLA EDP
description: Diptyque Eau Rihla is a mesmerizing and poetic amber woody fragrance inspired by the olfactory journeys through the Middle East. Highlighting a unique, velvety leather note intertwined with sweet raspberry and spicy saffron, it targets refined individuals looking for an exotic and artistic signature. This deeply warm and luxurious scent is highly recommended for cold evenings and sophisticated cultural events.

id: DIPTYQUE FLEUR DE PEAU EDP 75 ML
name: DIPTYQUE FLEUR DE PEAU EDP
description: Fleur de Peau by Diptyque is a sensuous, skin-like floral aldehyde fragrance created by Olivier Pescheux in 2018. Built around ambrette seed and iris with a veil of aldehydes and pink pepper, it evokes the intimacy of a second skin. The base of musk, ambergris, and a whisper of leather makes it deeply personal and warm.
descriptionAr: فلور دو بو من ديبتيك عطر جلدي زهري ألدهيدي حسي، ابتكره أوليفييه بيشو عام 2018. يرتكز على بذور الأمبريت والأيريس مع شفافية الألدهيدات والفلفل الوردي، مستحضرًا حميمية جلد ثانٍ. تجعل قاعدة من المسك والعنبر الرمادي ولمسة من الجلد هذا العطر شخصيًا للغاية ودافئًا.
baseNotes: Musk, Ambrette, Carrot, Ambergris, Sandalwood, Leather, Amberwood

name: DIPTYQUE L'EAU PAPIER EDT
description: L'Eau Papier by Diptyque, launched in 2023 and created by Fabrice Pellegrin, evokes the comforting scent of fresh ink on crisp paper. Toasted sesame and yellow mimosa form a subtly savory, powdery opening, while a white musk heart adds delicate softness. The base settles into a barely-there whisper of musk and warm woods, making this an intimate skin scent.
descriptionAr: لو بابييه من ديبتيك، أطلقه فابريس بليغران عام 2023، يستحضر رائحة الحبر الطازج على ورق ناعم. يُكوِّن السمسم المحمص والميموزا الصفراء افتتاحًا مالحًا بودريًا رفيعًا، بينما يُضيف قلب المسك الأبيض نعومةً رقيقة. تستقر القاعدة في همسة خافتة من المسك والأخشاب الدافئة، مما يجعل هذا العطر تجربة حميمية تلامس الجلد.

name: DIPTYQUE ORPHEON EDP
description: Diptyque OrphÃ©on is a nostalgic woody chypre fragrance inspired by a legendary 1960s Parisian jazz bar. Highlighting crisp juniper berries, soft jasmine, and warm powdery cedar, it targets lovers of chic, genderless niche scents. A beautifully refined, clean, and highly versatile perfume perfect for year-round wear.

name: DIPTYQUE TAM DOA EDP
description: Tam Dao Eau de Parfum by Diptyque is a meditative woody fragrance inspired by precious Goa sandalwood and the exotic spices of Asia, launched in 2013. The opening sparkles with lime, ginger, and coriander before the heart unfolds as a serene, dry blend of sandalwood, cedar, and amberwood. A warm base of amber and musk ensures a smooth, lasting finish.
descriptionAr: تام داو أو دو بارفيم من ديبتيك عطر خشبي تأملي مستوحى من خشب الصندل الثمين من غوا والتوابل الغريبة من آسيا، أُطلق عام 2013. يتلألأ الافتتاح بالليمون الأخضر والزنجبيل والكزبرة قبل أن يتكشف القلب كمزيج هادئ وجاف من الصندل والأرز وخشب العنبر. تضمن قاعدة دافئة من العنبر والمسك إنهاءً سلسًا وطويل الأمد.

name: DIPTYQUE VETYVERIO EDP
description: Diptyque Vetyverio is an incredibly chic and sophisticated woody floral musk that brilliantly bridges the gap between masculine vetiver and feminine florals. Featuring sharp grapefruit, a beautiful rose heart, and smooth Haitian vetiver, it is intended for elegant individuals who appreciate high-end, unisex Parisian perfumery. This beautifully balanced and clean scent is perfect for professional settings and crisp spring days.
topNotes: Grapefruit, Amalfi Lemon, Mandarin Orange, Bergamot
heartNotes: Geranium, Nutmeg, Rose, Clove, Ylang-Ylang, Carrot Seeds

name: DIRHAM (T) EDP
description: Ard Al Zaafaran Dirham is a highly popular, versatile Middle Eastern fragrance known for its clean, fresh profile. It opens with a sharp, invigorating blast of citrus and spicy cardamom. A clean, soapy heart of lavender and rose smoothly transitions into a reliable, masculine woody base of cedar and sandalwood. Offering fantastic value, it is the perfect everyday, fresh-out-of-the-shower scent for the modern man.

name: DIRHAM GOLD EDP
description: Dirham Gold is presented as a floral fragrance combining fruity, spicy and woody facets. Its listed pyramid includes pineapple and bergamot over vanilla, pepper, jasmine, rose and carnation, with sandalwood, tonka bean and vetiver underneath.
descriptionAr: درهم جولد هو عطر زهري يجمع بين الجوانب الفاكهية والحارة والخشبية. يضم الهرم المذكور الأناناس والبرغموت فوق الفانيلا والفلفل والياسمين والورد والقرنفل، مع خشب الصندل وحبوب التونكا والفيتيفر في القاعدة.

name: DIRHAM PINK
description: Dirham Pink by Ard Al Zaafaran is a sweet and joyful floral fruity gourmand fragrance starting with juicy blackcurrant and orange blossom. A heart of iris, jasmine, and delicious praline creates a powdery sweetness that is highly addictive. With a warm base of vanilla and patchouli, it is an affordable, crowd-pleasing scent for everyday wear.

name: DIRHAM SILVER (O) EDP
description: Lattafa Dirham Silver is a very fresh, clean, and energetic woody aromatic fragrance that offers exceptional everyday value. Blending bright citrus, soothing lavender, and smooth sandalwood, it caters to men who want a reliable, just-showered scent profile. Highly versatile and unobtrusive, it is the perfect easy-reach fragrance for the gym, office wear, and casual weekend errands.

id: DIRTY ENGLISH FOR MAN EDT 100 ML
name: DIRTY ENGLISH FOR MAN EDT
description: Dirty English for Men by Juicy Couture is a rugged woody-spicy fragrance launched in 2008, created by perfumer Claude Dir. The opening delivers spiced citrus with mandarin, bergamot, and caraway, before a leathery heart of atlas cedar and vetiver adds masculine depth. The base is anchored by oud, ebony, and oakmoss, delivering an edgy, lasting finish.
descriptionAr: ديرتي إنغليش للرجال من جوسي كوتور عطر خشبي توابلي قوي، أطلقه العطار كلود دير عام 2008. يقدم الافتتاح حمضيات متبلة بالماندرين والبيرغاموت والكراوية، قبل أن يُضيف قلب جلدي من أطلس أرز والفيتيفير عمقًا ذكوريًا. تتمحور القاعدة حول العود والأبنوس وطحلب البلوط، مما يخلق إنهاءً جريئًا وطويل الأمد.
topNotes: Cedar, Mandarin Orange, Cardamom, Bergamot, Caraway
heartNotes: Leather, Atlas Cedar, Sandalwood, Vetiver, Marjoram

name: DISCLOSURE FOR MEN EDT
description: Sapil Disclosure is a highly professional and invigorating woody spicy fragrance that perfectly balances freshness with robust masculinity. Zesty grapefruit and energetic spices are expertly anchored by an elegant vetiver base, making it an ideal choice for the ambitious gentleman. Project confidence and clean sophistication in the office with this outstanding, everyday signature scent.

name: DISCLOSURE SET NEW EDT
description: Experience reliable, everyday freshness with Malhotra Disclosure, a versatile and energetic fragrance designed for the active, no-nonsense man. Combining a crisp, clean opening of lavender and citrus with a grounding, warm woody base, it provides a familiar and universally pleasing masculine profile. Highly practical and approachable, it is an excellent, affordable choice for daily office wear, gym sessions, and casual weekends.

name: DISIRADE MY DESIRE EDP
description: Fulfill your romantic desires with juicy Peach and delicate Rose. This charming Floral Fruity fragrance ensures a warm, comforting vanilla finish. It is highly recommended for everyday wear and casual outings.

name: DIVA CHIC PINK EDP
description: Discover the captivating allure of PANUCCI DIVA CHIC PINK, a masterfully blended woody floral fragrance. It opens with vibrant bergamot, citrus, pink pepper, leading into a sophisticated heart of rose, jasmine, floral accords that perfectly balances the composition. Anchored by a warm base of musk, vanilla, sandalwood, this scent is ideal for everyday wear, spring/summer and offers an unforgettable olfactory experience for the modern enthusiast.

name: DIVA GLAMOROUS GIRL EDP
description: Embrace your inner femme fatale with Fragrance World Diva Glamorous Girl, a breathtakingly sexy, sweet, and intoxicating evening fragrance. Boasting an addictive, rich blend of creamy almond, roasted coffee, sensual tuberose, and sweet cacao, it is crafted for the glamorous, confident woman. An incredible, high-performing budget option for date nights, clubbing, and anytime you want to feel utterly irresistible.

name: DIVA NUIT EDP
description: Diva Nuit is a floral woody musk fragrance with bergamot and black pepper in the opening. Floral and powdery notes develop into a soft base of musk, sandalwood and vanilla.
descriptionAr: ديفا نويت هو عطر زهري خشبي مسكّي يبدأ بالبرغموت والفلفل الأسود. تتطور النفحات الزهرية والبودرية إلى قاعدة ناعمة من المسك وخشب الصندل والفانيلا.

name: DIVA UNGARO EDP
description: Diva by Emanuel Ungaro is a classic chypre floral fragrance that epitomizes timeless sophistication and feminine glamour. Featuring a complex blend of aldehydes, opulent roses, and a rich, honeyed oakmoss base, it is tailored for the confident, mature woman. Command attention at formal events and glamorous evenings with this luxurious, long-lasting vintage masterpiece.
topNotes: Aldehydes, Coriander, Mandarin Orange, Tuberose, Bergamot, Cardamom
heartNotes: Carnation, Orris Root, Turkish Rose, Ylang-Ylang, Moroccan Rose, Narcissus, Jasmine
baseNotes: Honey, Iris, Amber, Sandalwood, Patchouli, Musk, Civet, Vanilla, Oakmoss, Vetiver

name: DIVA UNGARO EDP FOR WOMEN
description: Diva by Emanuel Ungaro is a classic chypre floral fragrance created by Jacques Polge in 1983. It opens with luminous aldehydes, bergamot, and spices before giving way to a richly complex, rose-centered floral heart. The deep base of oakmoss, civet, honey, and sandalwood makes this a timeless and powerfully feminine statement.

name: DKNY BE DELICIOUS EDP
description: Take a bite out of the Big Apple with DKNY Be Delicious, a legendary, high-energy fragrance that perfectly captures the lively spirit of New York City. Bursting with the incredibly crisp, mouth-watering juice of green apple, refreshing cucumber, and bright muguet, it is designed for the fun, optimistic, and youthful woman. Exceptionally vibrant and clean, it is the ultimate, uplifting signature scent for spring and summer days.

id: DKNY BE DELICIOUS FRESH BLOSSAM EDP 100 ML
name: DKNY BE DELICIOUS FRESH BLOSSAM EDP
description: DKNY Be Delicious Fresh Blossom is a delicate and uplifting floral fruity fragrance reminiscent of the first blooms of spring in Central Park. Blending bright grapefruit and apricot with a tender bouquet of rose and jasmine, it appeals to charming, youthful spirits. Refresh your daily routine with this incredibly light, pretty, and universally appealing daytime scent.

id: DKNY DONNA KARAN NEW YORK EDP 50 ML
name: DKNY DONNA KARAN NEW YORK EDP
description: DKNY by Donna Karan is a legendary fresh floral fragrance that captures the pulsating, energetic heartbeat of New York City. An invigorating mix of chilled vodka, tomato leaf, and vibrant florals makes it an ideal scent for the dynamic, urban woman on the go. Perfect for everyday wear, this crisp and lively perfume keeps you feeling refreshed from the office to the streets.
topNotes: Blood Orange, Chilled Vodka, Tomato Leaf

name: DKNY WOMEN EDP
description: Experience urban freshness with crisp Green Apple and vibrant Grapefruit. This energetic Floral Fruity scent captures the essence of a lively city. It is the ultimate go-to fragrance for warm summer days.

name: DKNY WOMEN EDP 100 ML․
description: DKNY Women is a floral fragrance with citrus and fruity facets. Mandarin, grapefruit and apricot lead into floral notes and a soft musk, amber and sandalwood base.
descriptionAr: دي كاي إن واي وومن هو عطر زهري مع جوانب حمضية وفاكهية. تبدأ تركيبته باليوسفي والجريب فروت والمشمش، ثم نفحات زهرية وقاعدة ناعمة من المسك والعنبر وخشب الصندل.

name: DOLBY POUR HOMME EDP
description: Chris Adams Dolby is a highly energetic and universally appealing fragrance that kicks off with a bright, juicy blast of lemon and crisp apple. A perfectly balanced and slightly spicy heart of cinnamon and classic florals provides a warm, highly versatile core for daily wear. Grounded by an exceptionally comforting base of vanilla and cedar, it represents an outstanding, compliment-pulling signature scent.

name: DOLCE &GABBANA POUR FEMME EDT
description: Dolce & Gabbana Pour Femme Eau de Toilette is a feminine floral fragrance with fruity and powdery nuances. Neroli, raspberry and green mandarin lead to orange blossom and jasmine over a soft vanilla, sandalwood and marshmallow base.
descriptionAr: دولتشي آند غابانا بور فام أو دو تواليت هو عطر نسائي زهري مع لمسات فاكهية وبودرية. تبدأ تركيبته بالنيرولي والتوت واليوسفي الأخضر، ثم زهر البرتقال والياسمين فوق قاعدة ناعمة من الفانيلا وخشب الصندل والمارشميلو.

id: DOLCE& GABBANA EDP MEN TESTER NEW CODE
name: DOLCE& GABBANA EDP MEN TESTER NEW CODE
DOLCE&GABBANA DEVOTION MEN EDP
description: Devotion Pour Homme Eau de Parfum is a woody-spicy fragrance for men. Lemon opens the composition, followed by coffee and a patchouli-led base.
descriptionAr: ديفوشن بور هوم أو دو بارفان هو عطر خشبي حار للرجال. تبدأ تركيبته بالليمون، ثم القهوة، وتستقر على قاعدة يهيمن عليها الباتشولي.

name: DOLCE&GABBANA KING EDP MEN
description: Dolce & Gabbana K is a charismatic and vibrant woody aromatic fragrance that captures the essence of the modern man. With uplifting notes of blood orange, spicy pimento, and earthy cedarwood, it targets confident individuals who are the kings of their everyday lives. This refreshing scent is perfectly suited for daily office wear, warm-weather outings, and casual weekends.

id: DOLCE&GABBANA LIGHT BLUE EDT MEN TESTER
name: DOLCE&GABBANA LIGHT BLUE EDT MEN
description: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue is a quintessentially fresh floral fruity fragrance that evokes the sparkling spirit of the Mediterranean summer. Featuring crisp notes of Sicilian lemon, green apple, and bamboo, it is designed for women who love a clean, breezy, and casual scent. This iconic and refreshing perfume is the ultimate staple for hot summer days and relaxed beach vacations.

id: DOLCE&GABBANA THE ONE EDP INTENSE 100ML NEW C
name: DOLCE&GABBANA THE ONE EDP INTENSE 100ML NEW C
description: The One for Men Eau de Parfum Intense is an amber woody fragrance built around cardamom, cypress and neroli. Benzoin, cashmeran and clary sage lead to a leather, labdanum and patchouli base.
descriptionAr: ذا ون فور مين أو دو بارفان إنتنس هو عطر خشبي وعنبرى يرتكز على الهيل والسرو والنيرولي. تتطور التركيبة عبر البنزوين والكاشميران والمريمية إلى قاعدة من الجلد واللابدانوم والباتشولي.

id: DOMINIQUE ROPION HOPE FREDERIC MALLE EDP100ML
name: DOMINIQUE ROPION HOPE FREDERIC MALLE EDP
description: Hope by Frederic Malle (Dominique Ropion) is a masterful and uplifting woody fragrance that begins with sharp pink pepper and crisp juniper. A perfectly balanced heart of refined cedar and vetiver creates a highly sophisticated and versatile core for the contemporary wearer. The smooth, earthy base of amber and patchouli ensures a seamless transition from daytime professionalism to evening elegance.

name: DORIANE LOVE EDP
description: Sisley Doriane Love is an uplifting and joyful floral fruity fragrance that bursts with lively citrus and sweet fruits. Showcasing a delightful floral heart paired with a soft musky base, it is aimed at cheerful women looking for a light and romantic signature scent. This perfume shines beautifully during daytime activities and breezy spring afternoons.

id: DORSAY FLOWER LUST EXTRAIT DE PARFUM 90 ML
name: DORSAY FLOWER LUST EXTRAIT DE PARFUM
description: D'Orsay Flower Lust Extrait is an incredibly potent and intoxicating amber floral fragrance that delivers a rich, highly concentrated floral experience. Showcasing an opulent bouquet of rose and ylang-ylang grounded by deep patchouli and vanilla, it targets women seeking a luxurious, romantic signature. With its massive projection and longevity, it is perfectly suited for grand evening events and romantic nights.

id: DORSAY TONKA HYSTERIA EXTRAIT DE PARFUM 90 ML
name: DORSAY TONKA HYSTERIA EXTRAIT DE PARFUM
description: Tonka Hysteria by D'Orsay is a luxurious amber floral extrait de parfum created by Jordi Fernández in 2024, available in 50 ml and 90 ml sizes. It opens with aromatic olibanum, cinnamon, and mandarin before a creamy iris and lily of the valley heart adds floral elegance. The base of tonka bean, vanilla, and benzoin creates a rich, lingering sweetness with impressive sillage.
descriptionAr: تونكا هيستيريا من دورساي استخلاص عطري عنبري زهري فاخر، ابتكره خوردي فيرنانديز عام 2024، وهو متاح بحجمي 50 و90 مل. يفتح بلبان عطري وقرفة وماندرين قبل أن يُضفي قلب كريمي من الأيريس وزنبق الوادي أناقةً زهرية. تخلق قاعدة من حبة التونكا والفانيليا والبنزوين حلاوةً غنيةً وطويلة مع زخم عطري لافت.

name: DRAKKAR INTENSE EDP
description: Drakkar Intense by Guy Laroche is a modern aromatic fougère for men, launched in 2022 as a contemporary reinterpretation of the classic Drakkar. It opens with invigorating wormwood, coriander, and bergamot before a soothing heart of lavender and clary sage emerges. The base of patchouli, moss, and suede provides a warm, earthy, and distinctly masculine finish.
descriptionAr: دراكار إنتنس من جي لاروش فوجير عطري حديث للرجال، أُطلق عام 2022 بوصفه إعادة تفسير معاصرة للدراكار الكلاسيكي. يفتح بالشيح المنعش والكزبرة والبيرغاموت قبل أن يظهر قلب مريح من الخزامى والمريمية الحقلية. تمنح قاعدة الباتشولي والطحلب والسويد إنهاءً دافئًا وترابيًا وذكوريًا.

name: DRAKKAR NOIR EDT
description: Drakkar Noir by Guy Laroche is a landmark aromatic fougère for men, created by Pierre Wargnye and launched in 1982. The opening is a vigorous herbal-aromatic accord of lavender, rosemary, and citrus, underscored by green artemisia. A spiced floral heart of carnation and juniper leads to a rich, dry base of leather, oakmoss, and fir for an unmistakably masculine and enduring finish.
descriptionAr: دراكار نوار من جي لاروش فوجير عطري رائد للرجال، ابتكره بيير وارنيه وأُطلق عام 1982. يُعدّ الافتتاح عقدًا عشبيًا عطريًا قويًا من الخزامى وإكليل الجبل والحمضيات، تدعمه خضرة الرعي. يقود قلب زهري متبل من القرنفل والعرعر إلى قاعدة غنية وجافة من الجلد وطحلب البلوط والشجر الصنوبري، لإنهاء ذكوري لا لبس فيه.
topNotes: Lavender, Lemon, Bergamot, Rosemary, Mint, Lemon Verbena, Basil, Artemisia
heartNotes: Juniper, Carnation, Cinnamon, Wormwood, Coriander, Angelica, Jasmine
baseNotes: Oakmoss, Pine Tree Needles, Fir, Leather, Vetiver, Patchouli, Sandalwood, Cedar, Amber, Resins

description: Discover the captivating allure of GUY LAROCHE DRAKKAR NOIR, a masterfully blended aromatic fougere fragrance. It opens with vibrant bergamot, pepper, grapefruit, leading into a sophisticated heart of geranium, lavender, elemi that perfectly balances the composition. Anchored by a warm base of ambroxan, cedar, patchouli, this scent is ideal for signature scent, all seasons and offers an unforgettable olfactory experience for the modern enthusiast.

name: DSQUARED2 WOOD POUR FEMME EDT
description: Connect with nature through zesty Lemon and rugged White Woods. This modern Woody Floral Musk fragrance delivers a fresh, confident vibe. It is highly recommended for casual outings and everyday adventures.

id: DSQUARED2 WOOD POUR HOME EDT TESTER

descriptionAr: بينك بوكيه عطر أنثوي شبابي ومبهج من عائلة الأزهار الفواكه، يبدأ بالتوت والأناناس والبرغموت. يتفتح قلبه بباقة زهرية رقيقة من الفاوانيا وزهرة الزنبق والبنفسج والياسمين، فيما تضيف القاعدة الدفء بالبسكويت بالزنجبيل والخوخ والمسك وخزب البلوط. تركيبة حلوة ومنعشة في زجاجة موسكينو الأيقونية على شكل قلب.

name: MOSCHINO POUR FEMME EDT
description: Moschino Pour Femme is a rich and expressive Amber women's eau de toilette with a bold opening of galbanum, marigold, plum, honeysuckle, and freesia. The spiced floral heart weaves nutmeg, carnation, pepper, ylang-ylang, gardenia, and rose into a warm and complex core, while the base rests on amber, sandalwood, patchouli, vanilla, and musk. A powerful and long-lasting classic with unmistakable presence.
descriptionAr: موسكينو بور فام عطر أنثوي فاخر من عائلة العنبر، يفتتح بقوة بالجلبانوم والقطيفة والبرقوق وزهرة العسل والفريزيا. قلبه المتبل والزهري يجمع جوزة الطيب والقرنفل والفلفل والإيلنج إيلنج والغارديانيا والورد في قلب دافئ ومتعدد الأوجه، فيما تستقر القاعدة على العنبر وخشب الصندل والباتشولي والفانيليا والمسك. كلاسيكي قوي وذو ثبات عالٍ لا يُنسى.
heartNotes: Nutmeg, Carnation, Pepper, Ylang-Ylang, Gardenia, Rose

name: MOSCHINO TOY 2 EDP
description: Toy 2 EDP is a light and airy Floral Woody Musk women's fragrance that opens with apple, mandarin orange, and magnolia. The floral heart reveals white currant, peony, and jasmine in a delicate and clean accord, while the base settles into musk, sandalwood, and amberwood. A fresh and modern scent that evokes the freedom of play.
descriptionAr: توي 2 إي دي بي عطر أنثوي خفيف وهوائي من عائلة الأزهار الخشبية المسكية، يفتتح بالتفاح والماندرين والمانيوليا. قلبه الزهري يكشف الكشمش الأبيض والفاوانيا والياسمين في توافق رقيق ونظيف، فيما تستقر القاعدة على المسك وخشب الصندل وخشب العنبر. عطر منعش وعصري يستحضر روح المرح والانطلاق.

name: MOSCHINO TOY BOY EDP
description: Toy Boy EDP is a bold and unconventional Woody Spicy men's fragrance with a complex opening of Italian bergamot, green pear, elemi, pink pepper, and Indonesian nutmeg. The heart features magnolia, rose absolute, clove bud, and flax flower in an intriguing masculine floral accord, while the base combines Haitian vetiver, cashmeran, sandalwood, amber, and musk. A distinctive and polarizing composition unlike any traditional men's fragrance.
descriptionAr: توي بوي إي دي بي عطر رجالي جريء وغير تقليدي من عائلة الخشب المتبل، يفتتح بمزيج معقد من البرغموت الإيطالي والكمثرى الخضراء والإليمي والفلفل الوردي وجوزة الطيب الإندونيسية. قلبه يجمع المانيوليا والورد المطلق وبرعم القرنفل وزهرة الكتان في توافق زهري رجالي مثير، فيما تمزج القاعدة بين الفيتيفر الهايتيني والكاشميران وخشب الصندل والعنبر والمسك. عطر متميز ومثير للجدل لا يشبه أي عطر رجالي تقليدي.
topNotes: Italian Bergamot, Green Pear, Elemi, Pink Pepper, Indonesian Nutmeg
heartNotes: Magnolia, Rose Absolute, Clove Bud, Flax Flower
baseNotes: Haitian Vetiver, Cashmeran, Sandalwood, Amber, Sylkolide

The vibrant heart weaves together bubble gum, Bulgarian rose, peach, blueberry, peach blossom, cinnamon, and ginger in a lively and colourful accord, while the base settles into musk, ambroxan, and cedar. A fun and whimsical scent full of youthful energy.
descriptionAr: توي 2 بابل غام إي دي تي عطر أنثوي مرح وحلو من عائلة الأزهار الفواكه، يفتتح بالفواكه المسكرة والبرتقال المر والليمون. قلبه النابض بالحياة يمزج البابل غام والورد البلغاري والخوخ والبلوبيري وزهرة الخوخ والقرفة والزنجبيل في توافق ملون ومبهج، فيما تستقر القاعدة على المسك والأمبروكسان وخشب الأرز. عطر مرح وخيالي يفيض بطاقة الشباب.
heartNotes: Bubble Gum, Bulgarian Rose, Peach, Blueberry, Peach Blossom, Cinnamon, Ginger

description: Moschino Uomo is a clean and versatile Woody Floral Musk men's eau de toilette that opens with kumquat, aldehydes, coriander, and Brazilian rosewood. The heart offers cyclamen, clary sage, cinnamon, and labdanum in a fresh and aromatic accord, while the base closes with musk, ambergris, cedar, and wormwood. A refined and timeless masculine with a powdery, softly aldehydic character.
descriptionAr: موسكينو أومو عطر رجالي نظيف ومتعدد الاستخدامات من عائلة الأزهار الخشبية المسكية، يفتتح بالكومكوات والألدهيدات والكزبرة وخشب الورد البرازيلي. قلبه يقدم السايكلامان والمريمية الرومية والقرفة واللبدانم في توافق منعش وعطري، فيما تختتم القاعدة بالمسك والعنبرغري وخشب الأرز والأفسنتين. عطر رجالي راقٍ وخالد ذو طابع مسحوقي ناعم.

description: Moschino Fresh Couture is a bright floral-fruity Eau de Toilette with a citrus opening. Peony and fruity notes lead to a clean woody and musky base.

The heart blooms with orange blossom and neroli in a clean floral interlude, while the base adds warmth with musk, amber, and vanilla. A hidden-gem composition that balances freshness with subtle depth.

A fruity-floral composition with a bright cherry opening and a sweet drydown.
descriptionAr: فيزي شيري عطر موحد للجنسين نابض بالحيوية من عائلة العنبر الزهري من إم بي إف، يفتتح بالفلفل الوردي والزنجبيل والكرز. قلبه الزهري يمزج زهرة الزنبق والإيلنج إيلنج والياسمين في توافق أبيض زهري منعش، فيما تستقر القاعدة على ختام ناعم ودافئ من العنبر والمسك وفول التونكا. تركيبة زهرية فواكهية بافتتاح كرزي مشرق وقاعدة حلوة.

The heart blooms with orange blossom, white flowers, and jasmine in a fresh floral phase, while the base closes with a creamy and warm accord of musk, sandalwood, patchouli, vanilla, and honey. A lush and inviting peach-centred composition.
descriptionAr: جاست بيتش عطر موحد للجنسين فواكهي وحلو من عائلة الأزهار الفواكه الحلوة من إم بي إف، يفتتح بالبرغموت والهيل والخوخ والأوكالبتوس مع توافق الكحول. قلبه يتفتح بزهرة البرتقال والأزهار البيضاء والياسمين في مرحلة زهرية منعشة، فيما تختتم القاعدة بتوافق كريمي ودافئ من المسك وخشب الصندل والباتشولي والفانيليا والعسل. تركيبة غنية وجذابة تتمحور حول الخوخ.

descriptionAr: مستر بربري عطر خشبي عطري يفتتح بالجريب فروت والهيل والنعناع. يبني ورق البتولا وخشب الأرز واللافندر قلباً أخضر متبلاً، بينما يمنح نبات الفيتيفر وخشب الغاياك وخشب الصندل قاعدة دخانية ذات ملمس مميز. عطر عصري ومتعدد الاستخدامات مناسب للارتداء اليومي.

descriptionAr: فيرتوس بنغال عطر مركّز جلدي جذاب للرجال والنساء، يُفتتح بنضارة الأعشاب من الداف والبرغموت والزنجبيل. يكشف القلب عن مزيج غني من الجلد والباتشولي والورد — لقاء بين القوة البدائية والأناقة الزهرية. يُتمّ العنبر والسويد وخشب الصندل والفانيليا في القاعدة التركيبة بحسية دافئة ومحيطة.
